channel.title: The AI Edge
channel.description: AI is changing your work, your wallet and your everyday life. The AI Edge is your weekday artificial intelligence news and analysis podcast—with three voices you’ll want to spend your morning with. Alex asks the question you were thinking and keeps the conversation moving. Jamie brings the heart, the mischief and the excitement when something genuinely deserves it. Rufus follows the money, spots the absurdity and delivers the dry English observation nobody saw coming. They challenge the claims, tease each other and work through the possibilities together. Three distinct AI stories, useful discoveries, honest uncertainty and something to take into your day. What changed. Who wins. What you do next. New episodes Monday through Friday. Follow The AI Edge and join the conversation. Created by Daniel Wabs. AI-voiced cast. Sponsored by The Ledger: https://theledgr.io

item.title: AP reports AI-related stocks sold off after hot US inflation data
item.description:
AI stocks took a hit yesterday after inflation numbers came in hotter than expected. We’re breaking down why the market is suddenly jittery about the cost of building the future.
What we covered: • AP reports AI-related stocks sold off after hot US inflation data • Eight US States Sue OpenAI Over ChatGPT Safety Concerns • Global Financial Stability Board Issues Final Guidance on Agentic AI Oversight
Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.
Listener question: If an AI agent makes a mistake at work, who should be held responsible?
What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.
Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
